headline: Profitable, but RM954 is stuck in errors and one supplier is quietly raising prices

decisions.title: Recover a duplicate payment
decisions.action: Ask Ladang Susu Segar Hulu for a refund or credit note for invoice LSS/2609/278.
decisions.reason: RM642.00 was paid twice, on 15 Sep (IBG0915S02) and 16 Sep (IBG0916S02). Your ledger shows it once.
decisions.confidenceNote: Both bank lines and the ledger row are in your files.

decisions.title: Challenge the coffee powder price rise
decisions.action: Ask Kopi Cap Bintang to explain the rise on Serbuk Kopi O, or get two alternative quotes.
decisions.reason: Price went RM28.00 → RM31.36 (+12%) in three steps since 15 Jul with no notice. Teh powder and robusta did not change. ≈ RM983 a year at current volume.

decisions.title: Apply to TEKUN Niaga for the RM40k renovation
decisions.action: Start a TEKUN Niaga (SPK) application; check BNM SME SRF too.
decisions.reason: Micro, Bumiputera owner aged 34, SSM-registered since 2021: meets TEKUN criteria. PUNB GROW needs RM300k turnover: you are ~RM47k short. AIM needs household income, which we asked about.
decisions.confidenceNote: Depends on household income, which the owner has not given yet.
